_meta.purpose: ILLUSTRATIVE payment-demo configuration, read only by tools/serve_pricing_preview.py --state demo (in memory). NOT a Lacks or lender offer, NOT verified, NOT approved. Never copy into incoming/, data/ or the workbook.
_meta.factors: Each exampleFactor is the standard amortization factor r/(1-(1+r)^-n), r = APR/12, rounded to 6 decimals; it is an EXAMPLE input, never a published factor. 9.99% x 72 happens to equal the factor Lacks publishes for its own 9.99%/72 offer (0.018521); the demo plans are examples, not that offer.
_meta.provider: 'Demo' is deliberately not a lender name: no example plan may be read as a Synchrony or Lacks offer.
_meta.honesty: Served in memory with verified:false, verificationStatus 'illustrative' and paymentCalculationEnabled false; the app calculates them only through its demo admission adapter, which needs this harness's page context AND the validated illustrativeDemo config.
